textos.A maioria de quem recomenda destaca posi: Most of those who recommend it positively highlight the construction of the script and the handling of the narrative. On the other hand, most of those who do not recommend it point to weaknesses in the plot due to a lack of originality, and judge that the production received more praise and expectation than it really warranted.
textos.Várias reviews reclamam que o filme é ar: Several reviews complain that the film is slow and too long, with stretches that could be shortened and that make the experience tiring.

textos.Muitos membros deste grupo acham que o f: Many members of this group think the film gets exaggerated praise and does not live up to the reputation as a classic that it has.
textos.Há comentários negativos sobre a atuação: There are negative comments about the acting of some actors, considered weak or lacking charisma, although Joaquin Phoenix's performance is sometimes praised.

textos.Várias reviews medianas reclamam que o f: Several middling reviews complain that the film is long and dragging, with parts that seem to stretch on needlessly, especially in the first third and the middle, making the experience tiring for some.
textos.Este grupo destaca atuações convincentes: This group highlights convincing performances, especially from Russell Crowe and Joaquin Phoenix, although some criticize certain casting choices or consider that the protagonist does nothing exceptional.
textos.As reviews medianas apontam que a trama: The middling reviews point out that the plot is predictable, with a basic revenge story and shallow characters, repeating formulas already seen in other films of the genre.
textos.A música é frequentemente elogiada, mas: The music is often praised, but some note similarities with scores from other films, such as Pirates of the Caribbean, and some say it carries the film on its own.
textos.Enquanto alguns apreciam as cenas de lut: While some enjoy the fight scenes and the choreography, others criticize the confusing filming, the excessive use of slow motion and the lack of clarity in the combat.
textos.A parte visual é bastante elogiada, com: The visual side is widely praised, especially the cinematography, the costumes and the grandeur of the sets, although some consider the aesthetic dated or lacking innovation.
textos.As reviews positivas destacam a performa: The positive reviews highlight Joaquin Phoenix's performance as the villain, describing it as intense, repulsive and able to make the audience hate the character.
textos.Russell Crowe é elogiado por sua atuação: Russell Crowe is praised for his restrained, charismatic performance, which carries the protagonist and gives the story emotional weight.
textos.As sequências de ação, especialmente as: The action sequences, especially the battles and the fights in the arena, are described as impressive, well shot and thrilling.
textos.A trilha sonora é frequentemente mencion: The soundtrack is often mentioned as a high point, with comments on its grandeur and how well it suits the epic narrative.
textos.A direção de Ridley Scott é elogiada por: Ridley Scott's direction is praised for its skill in balancing action, political drama and emotion, contributing to the film's overall quality.
textos.O roteiro é destacado por sua estrutura: The script is highlighted for its well-built structure, with an engaging plot and twists that keep interest, although some point to predictability.

textos.Lançado em 2000 e dirigido por Ridley Sc: Released in 2000 and directed by Ridley Scott, Gladiator is an epic action and adventure drama set in the Roman Empire. The plot follows an army commander who, after his family is murdered and he is removed from his post by the new emperor, comes to live as a gladiator while seeking his revenge.
textos.A produção se estrutura em uma narrativa: The production is built on a long-running narrative, interspersing measured dramatic passages with large-scale combat sequences.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~89%), boa: In the vast majority of ratings (~89%), a good portion praise the intensity of the antagonist played by Joaquin Phoenix, while a significant share highlight Russell Crowe's charismatic presence in carrying the narrative. In addition, many emphasize the grandeur and technical handling of the battle scenes and the arena confrontations.
textos.Para quem se situa numa fração mínima da: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~10%), the impact is moderate: several point out that the pacing drags and the length feels excessive in certain stretches. Within this same band, a considerable number acknowledge the cast's good performance, although a good portion criticize the story's predictability and its use of very familiar narrative conventions.
textos.Já na leitura presente numa fração ainda: In the reading found in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), the film is seen with frustration given prior expectations: a significant share complain of structural slowness and excessive screen time, several consider the plot weak and derivative, and a portion classify the work as overrated relative to its recognition.
